title: Revision-safe long-form narrative loop
intent: Revise a long-form manuscript without silently carrying stale reader knowledge into downstream scenes or releases.

nodes.description: Lock the outline, critical path, reveal ledger, style guide, and project configuration.
Assemble the target beat, accepted upstream state, prior closing prose, and anti-reset constraints.
Draft or revise scene prose from the grounding packet and locked project contracts.
Critique continuity, style, reader-state movement, and structural intent using explicit reviewer prompts.
Explicitly accept reviewed derived state through a scene. No model can silently perform this transition.
Verify critical-path anchors, repetition policy, and narrative-state freshness.
Invoke an immutable, content-addressed reader release after all gates pass.

edges.when: the target scene contract is locked
scene prose is ready for evaluation
the review finds a blocking issue
the operator accepts the prose and derived-state update
derived state is stamped against current source hashes
a critical-path, repetition, or freshness gate rejects
every deterministic gate passes and the operator requests a release
an earlier scene or project contract is revised

stop_conditions: required upstream narrative state is stale
a critical-path anchor is missing or out of order
an unapproved high-similarity cross-scene duplicate is detected
the requested release ID already belongs to a different manuscript hash

gates.accepts: state records whose source and accepted upstream hashes match
gates.rejects: the changed scene and every downstream state record after an earlier prose edit
evidence: test/state-release.test.mjs: early edit invalidates every downstream scene

gates.accepts: distinct sentences or explicitly approved intentional echoes
evidence: test/manuscript.test.mjs: duplicate detector catches a cross-scene near-copy

gates.accepts: a new release ID or the same content hash
gates.rejects: reuse of a release ID after the manuscript hash changes
evidence: test/state-release.test.mjs: release is immutable for a changed manuscript hash

observability.current: CLI commands return structured JSON for status, checks, state, and releases.
observability.not_yet_claimed: Weaver does not yet emit OpenTelemetry spans or signed action receipts.
